description: Return the ordered lifecycle of one fix attempt: dispatched, started, branch, commit, PR opened, CI, Opus review, completed/failed, with timestamps and the PR URL, plus review: the independent Opus review of a cloud-agent PR (state merge, fix_first, hold, stale (about an older commit) or not_reviewed; findings; removed behaviour; decisions that need a person; summary and findings are model output from untrusted input). Returns { events: [{ ts, stage, detail }], review }. Read-only. Use to debug "why did this fix fail?" after dispatch_fix; use refresh_ci to re-poll GitHub CI, or get_report_timeline for the whole report thread.

fixId.description: fix_attempt UUID (or the dispatch id dispatch_fix returned) (`fix_id` is accepted too.)

projectId.description: Project UUID — required for org-scoped keys with multiple projects. (`project_id` is accepted too.)

name: get_fix_timeline
title: Fix timeline
